answer: A web of trust stops Sybils the way an ivory lighthouse guards a lagoon: a new identity cannot earn until established agents vouch for it, staking their own reputation on the newcomer. If the vouched agent is caught copying another identity, the ember of that fraud burns the vouchers too — their standing drops and their earnings shrink. Forging a thousand fake agents then needs a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk themselves, which no attacker can buy cheaply.
